description: This file contains unit tests for the CatalogItemsSpecification class in the ApplicationCore project of eShopOnWeb, testing filtering of catalog items based on specified IDs.

classes.name: CatalogItemsSpecification
classes.description: A unit test class that verifies the behavior of CatalogItemsSpecification filtering logic.

methods.name: MatchesSpecificCatalogItem
methods.description: Tests that the specification correctly filters for a specific catalog item by ID.

methods.name: MatchesAllCatalogItems
methods.description: Tests that the specification correctly filters for multiple catalog items by IDs.

methods.name: GetTestCollection
methods.description: Creates a list of mock CatalogItem objects for testing purposes.
